Select A.TAG_NO AS TagNoL,A.DESIGN_NO AS DesignNoL,B.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,A.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,A.ITM_NWT AS NetWtW,A.ITM_MRP as MrpR,A.VCH_SRNO,A.VCH_NO As IsuNoL,A.CO_YEAR As IsuYearL,A.CO_BOOK As IsuBookL,A.OLD_SRNO As IsuSrNoL From APR_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.BOOK_NAME = 'APR ISU' AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND A.VCH_NO = ' ? ' AND A.ISU_REC = 'N' ORDER BY A.SR_NO

SELECT A.*,B.IT_NAME FROM APR_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND A.VCH_NO = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? ' AND VCH_SRNO = ? And A.BOOK_NAME = 'APR ISU' AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.ISU_REC = 'N'

SELECT A.*,B.IT_NAME FROM BAR_IDTL AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? ' AND A.VCH_SRNO = ?
UPDATE APR_DETL SET APR_DETL.ISU_REC = 'N' WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? ' AND VCH_NO = ' ? ' AND SR_NO = ' ? '

UPDATE BAR_DETL SET BAR_DETL.APP_TRFR = 'R' WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND TAG_NO = ' ? ' AND VCH_SRNO = ?

Select A.ORD_NO As OrdNoL,D.AC_NAME As AcNameL,A.TAG_NO AS TagNoL,A.DESIGN_NO AS DesignNoL,C.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,A.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,A.ITM_NWT AS NetWtW,A.ITM_MRP as MrpR,A.VCH_SRNO,A.ORD_YRCD As OrdYrCdL,A.ORD_DBCD As OrdDbCdL,A.ORD_SRNO As OrdSrNoL From ((BAR_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN SL_ORD_DETL AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.ORD_YRCD = B.CO_YEAR AND A.ORD_DBCD = B.CO_BOOK AND A.ORD_NO = B.VCH_NO AND A.ORD_SRNO = B.OLD_SRNO)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = C.IT_CODE) LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS D ON A.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND A.ORD_AC = D.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' and A.ORD_NO <> '' AND B.TAG_SALE = 'N' AND A.ORD_AC = ' ? ' ? A ? AND B.IT_TYPE = ' ? ' ? ORDER BY A.ORD_NO,A.TAG_NO

Select A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,A.VCH_TIME FROM BAR_DETL AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? ' AND A.VCH_SRNO = ? And A.EMP_ISU <> 'Y' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,A.VCH_TIME ORDER BY A.VCH_TIME DESC

Select A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,B.VCH_TIME FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = B.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = B.VCH_SRNO WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? ' ? AND A.VCH_SRNO = ? AND B.EMP_ISU <> 'Y' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,B.VCH_TIME HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN ='+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE - A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY B.VCH_TIME DESC

Select C.DESIGN_NO AS DesignNoL,B.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,A.TAG_NO AS TagNoL,C.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,C.ITM_NWT AS NetWtW,C.ITM_MRP as MrpR,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_TIME From (MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = C.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = C.VCH_SRNO)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO <> 'N' AND A.TAG_NO <> '' ? All ? AND B.IT_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND C.EMP_ISU <> 'Y' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,B.IT_NAME,A.IT_CODE,C.DESIGN_NO,C.ITM_GWT,C.ITM_NWT,C.ITM_MRP,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_TIME HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE -A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY SUBSTRING(C.DESIGN_NO,1,2), LEN(C.DESIGN_NO),C.DESIGN_NO,A.TAG_NO,C.VCH_TIME DESC

Select A.TAG_NO AS TagNoL,B.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,C.DESIGN_NO AS DesignNoL,C.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,C.ITM_NWT AS NetWtW,C.ITM_MRP as MrpR,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_TIME From (MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = C.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = C.VCH_SRNO)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO <> 'N' ? All ? AND B.IT_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND C.EMP_ISU <> 'Y' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,B.IT_NAME,A.IT_CODE,C.DESIGN_NO,C.ITM_GWT,C.ITM_NWT,C.ITM_MRP,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_TIME HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE -A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY A.TAG_NO,C.VCH_TIME DESC

' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND ITM_LOT = ' ? ' AND ITM_LOT <> '' AND TAG_NO = 'N' AND B.IT_TYPE = ' ? ' GROUP BY ITM_LOT HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_GWT ELSE -ITM_GWT END) > 0

' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.ITM_LOT <> '' AND TAG_NO = 'N' AND B.IT_TYPE = ' ? ' GROUP BY A.ITM_LOT,A.IT_CODE,B.IT_NAME ORDER BY A.ITM_LOT,B.IT_NAME
